_about: V3.1 decision register (post-TEST corrections after the external review of the V3.0 Excel export, and PDF checks of influential/extreme values). Separate from audit/v3_register.json, which is locked by the biomass pre-registration. PDF_CHECKED_VISUAL = the figure of the original article was inspected (PDFs supplied by the author on 2026-11-18). Confirmed extreme values are never removed.

v31_control_rebasing.evidence: Chitosan is dissolved in 2% acetic acid; the article defines the acetic-acid spray as the solvent control (external review 2026-11-18, confirmed in the original). lnRR = ln(SB.chitosan / S.vehicle).
AMF+NPK vs S confounds the fertilizer; the matching control is the NPK-only arm under the same drought (E1.SB.NPK).
